title: GitHub - GitHub Importer Maintenance
text:
Service: GitHub
Maintenance: GitHub Importer Maintenance
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2022-10-27T15:00:00.000Z
Scheduled until: 2022-10-27T16:00:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2022-10-27T16:00:30.676Z: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2022-10-27T15:00:28.761Z: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2022-10-20T16:54:10.562Z: scheduled - GitHub Importer—namely the “Import repository” (https://github.com/new/import) UI on GitHub.com and the "Source Imports" (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/migrations/source-imports) REST API—will be undergoing scheduled maintenance. During this time, no new source imports will be processed. You will not be able to start new source imports until the end of the maintenance window.

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

GitHub Importer—namely the “Import repository” (https://github.com/new/import) UI on GitHub.com and the "Source Imports" (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/migrations/source-imports) REST API—will be undergoing scheduled maintenance. During this time, no new source imports will be processed. You will not be able to start new source imports until the end of the maintenance window.
